decisions.reason: As an agency-oriented compliance tool tightly related to the hosting business and the firm's stated expansion of compliance capabilities, it is more likely to be refined through in-house learning than withdrawn.
Because the platform is a flagship product built directly on the firm's core hosting knowledge, infrastructure, and R&D base, management would strongly favor continued support.

This configurable managed hosting plan fits the firm's established capabilities well and should benefit from ongoing customer learning, though its weaker visible traction keeps withdrawal risk above the flagship products.

Extended PHP security support draws on the firm's core security and managed-service expertise and serves real legacy customer needs, but as a narrower and potentially transitional offer it has the highest chance of being folded back or discontinued.
